CLAUDE.md § The review half of `merge-policy` is a second session, not a bot: the exemption — and by the same asymmetry a clearance — is
for a PR nobody objected to, never over an objection somebody raised.

direction in which an unattributable marker still decides the set is
the fail-closed one
